{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.head())
print(df.info())

# Check for the QA orders with 999999.99 revenue
print("\nRows with revenue == 999999.99:")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
# First, ensure revenue is string type
if df['revenue'].dtype != 'object':
    df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(str)

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders count:")
print(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Check for the presence of 'converted' column
print("\nUnique values in 'converted':")
print(df['converted'].unique())"}
